description: Deterministic verified transform (sort/dedup/json/csv/case/date/extract…) re-executed on your input; ¢0.1; returns output + receipt. Call match or programs first to find the class.

input_kind.description: optional: what the input is (lines, csv, json, numbers, text, …); a kind that does not fit the program's `in` is refused before anything is metered

pow_challenge.description: The challenge from a payment_required result

pow_nonce.description: Nonce such that SHA-256(challenge || ':' || nonce) has difficulty_bits leading zero bits

work_token.description: Work-rail token (deai_wk_…) earned with the work tool; spends credit on this node. Same as sending Authorization: Bearer.

x_payment.description: x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 JSON, for the PaymentRequired in the result's `x402.v2.required` (when the USDC rail is open); x402 v1 is not accepted

name: run_program
title: Run a verified transform (0.0010)
